text:
lina: saw a 502 burst during eu-west canary while a scheduled node-drain overlapped with attach backoff. deploy-bot scheduled an auto-rollback (max-evict-time breach).
deploy-bot: Automated: promotion stalled. Will rollback in 5m unless manual pin annotation applied. Reason: 502s during eviction/attach.
lina: Infra confirms attach-controller backlog + new ASG scale. Not an app change.
sre-oncall: We can either extend eviction grace via rollout config or pin the HelmRelease to suppress auto-rollback. Pin is faster. Who can authorize?
harry: I can authorize. What's the quick pin command?
ops-eng: Run: `kubectl annotate helmrelease srvc-ingest-v1 release.redwood/pinned-by=lina release.redwood/pin-reason="attach-backoff-drain" --overwrite` then `deployctl rollout patch srvc-ingest-v1 --suppress-auto-rollback=true`. Include approver in annotation for audit.
lina: Applying pin now and patching rollout. Adding release-note: "temp pin due to node-drain PV attach backlog in eu-west; will rollback if persists >30m."
deploy-bot: Pin detected. Automated rollback suppressed for TTL 60m. Manual unpin: `kubectl annotate helmrelease srvc-ingest-v1 release.redwood/pinned-by-`. Audit recorded.
sre-oncall: Authorizing: sre-oncall. I'll monitor error budgets and attach-controller metrics. Create INFRA ticket to requeue attaches.
ops-eng: INFRA-4022 created: requeue disk attaches, investigate attach-controller scaling.
harry: Added a short changelog line: "Pinned canary during attach-controller backlog to avoid premature rollback."
lina: Plan: watch for 20-25m. If healthy at +22m unpin and let promotion continue; otherwise rollback at +30m.
deploy-bot: Reminder: suppression expires at 2860004710 (60m TTL) if not unpinned earlier.
sre-oncall: Metrics trending down at +12m. If stable at +22m I'll sign off to unpin.
lina: Unpinning at +22m after checks. Promotion resumed and completed. Closing thread.
